card.title: Polish
card.text: 76 modules from A1 to C1, with the cases, aspect and the virile plural explained step by step.

heading: Learn Polish with the grammar explained.
lead: A complete course in the standard Polish of Poland, from the alphabet to C1. All seven cases, verbal aspect, the virile plural and verbs of motion are taught directly, one step at a time, and every answer gets feedback that says why it was right or wrong.
fineprint: The whole course is free: all 76 modules, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test. Practice papers, specializations and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

panel.label: The course: eight tiers, 76 modules

items.title: Tier 1 · Sounds and first words
items.text: The alphabet and sounds, ty and Pan/Pani, gender, być, numbers.

items.title: Tier 2 · First sentences
items.text: The accusative and locative, plurals with virile forms, the past tense.

items.title: Tier 3 · The cases and aspect
items.text: Genitive, instrumental, dative and vocative, aspect and the future, verbs of motion.

items.title: Tier 4 · Building fluency
items.text: The imperative, się, numbers with nouns, comparison.

items.title: Tier 5 · Everyday fluency
items.text: Prefixed verbs of motion, the conditional, complex sentences, work and education.

items.title: Tier 6 · Intermediate
items.text: Participles, the impersonal and the passive, reported speech, the media.

items.title: Tier 7 · Upper intermediate
items.text: Verb government, word formation, formal address, law, business and official Polish.

items.title: Tier 8 · Advanced
items.text: Aspect nuances, word order, style, spoken Polish, history and literature.

panel.note: 76 modules in all. A placement test lets you start further up if you already know some Polish.

sections.heading: What the course teaches, and how

items.title: Grammar taught directly
items.text: Each module explains its grammar before you practise it: why kobieta becomes kobietę after a verb, when to use robić and when zrobić. A searchable grammar reference links each rule to the modules that teach it.

items.title: Feedback that says why
items.text: A wrong answer shows the correct one, the reason yours was wrong and a link to the rule. There is no limit on how many exercises you do.

items.title: Every word can be tapped
items.text: Tap any Polish word, anywhere in the course, for its meanings, its full table of forms, examples and audio.

items.title: Speaking with pronunciation feedback
items.text: Speaking exercises in the modules rate your pronunciation of Polish sentences, and the Polish in the course comes with audio.

items.title: From everyday to official Polish
items.text: The later tiers cover the language of work, the media, law, business and offices, and the last tier spoken Polish, style, history and literature.

sections.heading: Practice papers for the Polish certificate
sections.intro: The course has two timed practice papers each for the B1 and B2 levels of the egzamin certyfikatowy z języka polskiego jako obcego, Poland's state exam in Polish as a foreign language. B1 or higher is required for recognition as a Polish citizen, unless you have a Polish school certificate; B2 is what most university programmes expect.
items: Polish B1 and B2 certificate practice papers: what the exam asks, what the papers cover, and where they differ from the real exam.

sections.heading: 13 professional specializations
sections.intro: Each specialization has nine modules in three stages, Foundations, Working vocabulary and Professional, which open as you reach tiers 4, 6 and 8 of the course.

items.question: Is the Polish course really free?
items.answer: Yes. All 76 modules, the grammar reference, word practice and the placement test are free, with 5 Ask AI questions a day. Premium adds the extras listed above.

items.question: How far does the course go?
items.answer: From first words to C1, in eight tiers. The last tiers cover formal and official Polish, style, spoken Polish and literature.

items.question: I already know some Polish. Do I have to start at the beginning?
items.answer: No. The placement test finds the tier to start from.

items.question: Does it prepare me for the B1 exam for Polish citizenship?
items.answer: The course teaches Polish up to C1, and Premium adds timed practice papers for the B1 and B2 certificate. The papers have no oral part and are shorter than the real exam in listening, reading and grammar. The exam page has the details.

items.question: I speak Ukrainian. Is there a course for me?
items.answer: Yes. Polish for Ukrainian speakers is a shorter course of 40 modules, explained in Ukrainian and built around what differs from Ukrainian, with the same certificate papers.

closing.heading: Start with the first module.
